title: Define terminology and SGI roles, decision rights and approval
requirements:
- Define domain-specific reviewer qualifications, conflict-of-interest rules and multidisciplinary review
- Define who approves extensions, translations, value sets and mappings
- Add a RACI-style model assigning standards, terminology, model, clinical and publication authorities to capabilities
- Extend technical review to implementability and validation, and distinguish automated structural checks from expert judgement
- Include classification and clinical coding specialists
- Distinguish authoring roles (content author, domain authority, modeller, terminology specialist, reviewer, publisher) with separation of duties
- Require privacy, legal, ethical and equity review for high-impact artefacts, and proportionate public consultation
- Link ICD release adoption to statistical reporting
